en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a mid‑20th‑century European city in a valley, with a river or canal running through the center, several bridges, blocks of modernist apartment buildings along the water, denser older low‑rise buildings and church towers in the historic core, and hills or low mountains in the background. Part of an airplane wing is visible at the top right, reinforcing the bird's‑eye perspective. No visible printed caption or text can be seen on the image side.
